notes.title: Common'hood Beta 2 Celebration!
notes.notes:
We are celebrating the release of our next beta phase for Common'hood, the next project in the 'Hood series after Block'hood. As part of the celebration, Block'hood will be getting an 80% discount!

We heard your feedback loud and clear, and besides stomping down on the bugs you helped us find, we’ve focused our work on improving the game’s construction systems. 

Help us test them out! What kind of awesome buildings and furniture will you make and share in our online blueprint system? Which materials will you choose? Have we made the building process intuitive and smooth enough? And what’s this about an emotion system for the settlers we’ve been hearing about?

All of this will be answered on Beta 2! 
Wanna sign up? 

Get a steam key by following the steps below:

1 -  join our Discord at:
https://discord.gg/SrCPgQz

2 - Once you’re in there, hop into any of the public channels and type out:
“i want to test” 
(in any channel) 

Welcome to the 'Hood!

notes.title: Common'hood Public Demo
notes.notes:
Common'hood is the spiritual successor of Block'hood. We have spent several years working on a demo that we can finally share with the public. 

The demo contains the first chapter of the story mode as well as a sandbox mode that can be accessed once the story is finished. 

You can sign up for the demo for free on our discord server:
https://discord.gg/BTSzvZz

We are collecting feedback and impressions of the game to improve it in further development.
Hope you enjoy what we have to share!

notes.title: FINAL RELEASE MAY 11TH
notes.notes:
Dear Friends,
Thanks for your patience and support for the last year. We know it's been a while since the last update, but we wanted to be able to share the new content (The story mode) only when it was ready. 
The time has come to finally release Block'hood!

We will continue supporting the game and adding features over time, but we believe that with the addition of the Story Mode, we have reached the end of a chapter.

The final release coming on May 11th will include:
-5 chapter story mode.
-Localization for: Spanish, Japanese, Chinese, Russian, French, German and Portuguese.
-Steam achievements
-Optimized
-Re-balanced
-Increased max number of Blocks (from 800 to 3000)
-Agents habitats database
-Unlockable constrains. 

Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Premature Evaluation: Block hood
notes.notes:
One of the major selling-points of Cities: Skylines was that, unlike SimCity, its maps would let your cities sprawl for miles until they became the San Angeles-style megalopolises of your dreams (though with a cheerier, Scandinavian aesthetic sensibility and fewer killer androids. Run out of space for that next critical piece of utility infrastructure? No problem, just annex another 25 square miles of land and “bring the city to the water”, in the words of Chinatown’s Noah Cross.

Plethora-Project’s Block’hood [official site] takes the opposite approach. It describes itself as a “neighborhood builder” rather than a city-builder, and even its most generous maps limit your total buildable area to roughly the size of a postage-stamp or one of my old apartment buildings. No sooner have you started placing buildings that you’ve run out of space to expand. In order to keep growing and developing, you only have one choice: to grow up.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Experimental Architecture: Block hood On Early Access
notes.notes:
If you’re the sort to dream of utopian megablocks in elaborate, irregular shapes with crops and wind turbines on the roof and trees all around, you might be interested in Block’hood [official site]. If you’re me, I might mean. I’m interested in Block’hood. It’s a sim about building and managing small neighbourhoods, balancing commerce, energy, food, pollution, waste, and so on in an urban ecosystem. It looks somewhere between SimCity and SimTower, with maybe a touch of The Sims. And it looks pretty. And it has launched on Steam Early Access today.

… [visit site to read more]
